{{Quote|We attempted to capture the Eagle in a raid on Tholatin. We found the base, but the man had moved on.|[[Shara Jenn|Watcher Two]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Raid on Tholatin''' was undertaken by the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] in an attempt to capture the terrorist known as [[Eagle|The Eagle]] for the destruction of the [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']]. While the Imperial forces have been able to locate the terrorist's base of operations, it was already abandoned by then. [[Shara Jenn|Watcher Two]] later reported the results of the operation to [[Cipher Nine]], who was investigating Eagle's connection to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Ghost cell]] at the same time.
